name: ETHFIN public doBuyback swaps the buyback pot with zero minimum output
summary: EthernalFinanceII.doBuyback() is public (its comment says 'set to private') and, once N_holders reaches NextBuybackMemberCount, swaps 40% of the buyback pot's BNB for ETHFIN through PancakeRouter with amountOutMin 0; N_holders counts every first-time recipient, so 1-wei transfers to fresh addresses reach the threshold. The attacker pushed N_holders to the threshold with 1-wei transfers (from 0x8a490cac and in the anchor), flash-borrowed 12 WBNB from a PancakeSwap V3 pool, bought 54.72B ETHFIN with 11.68 WBNB from the ETHFIN/WBNB pair 0x3544da62, called doBuyback so the contract spent 2.63 BNB at the inflated price, sold the ETHFIN back for 14.13 WBNB and kept 2.23 BNB; it repeated this twice within 50 minutes.
notes: Earlier exploits: the contract emitted Buyback_ 20 times; the 17 before the anchor (blocks 12296127-35441189) were plain doBuyback() calls by the deployer 0xb2be75ae (one by 0x01db8538) with a single router swap and no surrounding trades. The anchor is the first sandwiched buyback; the same attacker 0x52e38d49 repeated it with fresh contracts in 0x416ac780 and 0x5a69de35, the last buybacks the contract made.

Reset is the deployment (0x13491966, 2021-10-27). resets.mjs lists no later change to the buyback logic: setAutoCalcRewards (0x96f45274), holders' ChooseSinglePayoutToken and ExcludefromTax calls, earlier buybacks' pot and threshold updates, liquidity moves, and the attacker's own holder-count inflation in 0x8a490cac 21 blocks before the anchor (part of the attack, rule 10).

Loss is the BNB that left the ETHFIN contract's buyback pot in the three transactions (loss.mjs --victims 0x17bd2e09: 2.631, 1.579 and 0.947 BNB). The attacker kept 4.75 BNB; the rest stayed in the ETHFIN/WBNB pair as fees and price impact (netting that pair in gives 2,916 USD) or paid the flash fees. The ETHFIN bought by the pot was burned.
